items.title: Intersection numbers with curves agree with degrees of restrictions
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The proof identifies the intersection number (L  dot  Z) with the leading coefficient of the degree-1 numerical polynomial n -> chi(Z, L|_Z^{tensor n}) and notes that for a degree-1 polynomial the leading coefficient is the difference of consecutive values, which is exactly deg(L|_Z) by its definition; the ampleness clause is definitional (deg_L). H2: the mechanism is a single sentence, but it packages the leading-term identification (delivered leading-term companion) and the definitional identities.
